description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home:* Great Outdoor Space - FOUR Porches* 4 Fun Pug Bikes Included* 0.4 Miles to Palms of Dune Allen Beach Access* Walk to Goatfeathers Rest., Local Catch Bar and Grill + local shops* 0.8 miles to Gulf Place: Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley, and more* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Seapointe Serenity, a beautifully crafted five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath coastal retreat just minutes from the white-sand beaches and the best of the 30A lifestyle. Designed for comfort and connection, this spacious home features four inviting porches—perfect for enjoying every season—including a stunning third-floor porch with sweeping horizon views of the Gulf. Inside, the chef’s dream kitchen makes it easy to prepare memorable meals, while the open living areas offer plenty of room for the whole family to gather and unwind. Bikes are included for exploring the area and soaking up the laid-back coastal vibe. You will find on the second floor, the master bedroom features a king bed, alongside a guest bedroom with a king bed and an additional guest room with a twin-over-twin bunk bed plus a queen sleeper sofa. The third floor offers two more guest bedrooms, each with a king bed, providing privacy and comfort for everyone. With thoughtful design, generous space, and coastal charm throughout, Seapointe Serenity is the perfect place to relax, reconnect, and create unforgettable seaside memories—where serenity truly meets the shore.The Bed Setup:2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed + Queen Sleeper Sofa3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom 4: King BedArea Attractions: Seapointe Serenity is perfectly situated, with Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away from the East. Located in an upscale area of Hwy 30A, this pristine house is perched between Destin and Seaside. Just a 13-minute drive to Grand Boulevard Town Center with over 35 shops and restaurants as well as the all-new state-of-the-art Boulevard 10 Movie Theater. Bike down to Blue Mountain Creamery for a cone or meander along the miles of trails! The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A comprises 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces, and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique among all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music, and a laid-back atmosphere. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
